verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents an official Mail MCP server that connects Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants to the inbox/calendar for summarizing, drafting, sending, and scheduling, with explicit send-approval controls, confirmed by a dedicated probe finding the official MCP page. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of the MCP server working (community evidence pack lacks any first-hand MCP usage reports) and technical details on the MCP server's implementation/spec compliance.
